Name: Slime Alchemist
Author: RiftstalkerSekun
Description:
Got more slime than you know what to do with? Why not try your hand at some simple alchemy? 
Slime Alchemist is a mod focused around making a small handful of potions to make tasks flow better, without trivializing them. Create potions, longer-lasting infusions, or even a couple of different gels to make doing your chores just a little bit better.

The Alchemy Station is learned at level 2 Combat, and requires 2 Iron Bar, 10 Wood, 10 Refined Quartz and 1 Fire Quartz to craft. Every potion/gel requires 10 slime and an item to create something, and each potion/gel takes 4 hours to complete the brewing process. Infusions are created by putting a potion and 10 more slime back into the Alchemy Station. Every combination is unlocked at the start, though a certain squirrely alchemist will be keeping an eye on your progress and sending you letters to remind you what can be made with what. Potions generally focus around buffing a Skill, or increasing passive health/energy restoration. By default, Potions last for 8 hours in-game time, and Infusions last for 12 hours, and that is the only difference between the two. (An exception is the Masterful Angling Potion/Infusion, because while the game clock is paused during the fishing minigame, the buff timers are not, and will continue to count down.) Gels are single-use instant consumables that restore Health or Energy.

Potions and Infusions are both considered to be Drinks, and therefore buff in the Drink slot. That means that they WILL stack with Food buffs, but will not stack with/will overwrite or be overwritten by other Drink buffs like Green Tea, Ginger Ale, etc.

[spoiler]
Apple Gel: Restores 50 Health. Requires 2 Apples, creates 2 Apple Gels.
Peach Gel: Restores 125 Energy. Requires 2 Peaches, creates 2 Peach Gels. I know, I know, it should be an Orange Gel instead, but I used Oranges in my soap mod and didn't want to double up on usage.
Plentiful Fields Potion: +4 Farming, +.5 Energy regen per second. Requires 1 Parsnip OR 1 Corn.
Earth's Bounty Potion: +5 Mining, +50 Max Energy. Requires 1 Bomb.
Tree's Bane Potion: +5 Foraging, +50 Max Energy. Requires 1 Field Snack.
Masterful Angling Potion: +3 Fishing. Requires 1 Catfish OR 1 Sturgeon.
Dancing Swords Potion: +4 Combat, +3 Attack, +3 Defense. Requires 1 Bug Steak.
Fleetfooted Potion: +2 Speed. Requires 1 Green Tea.
Gilded Luck Potion: +2 Luck. Requires 1 Ginger Ale.
Iron Defense Potion: +5 Defense, +5 Immunity, +2 Health regen per second. Requires 1 Crab.
Potion of Potencia: +100 Max Energy, +1.5 Energy regen per second. Requires 1 River Jelly.
Rapid Regeneration: +3 Health regen per second, +1.5 Energy regen per second. Requires 3 Radioactive Ore.

Infusions are a longer-lasting variant of Potion created by putting a Potion back into the Alchemy Station with 10 more Slime. 
Even at level 10, skills like Mining and Foraging continue to get energy cost reductions the higher the skill is leveled. This means that, for example, at Foraging 10 with an Earth's Bounty Potion, you'll have a total of 15 Foraging skill, meaning that every swing of your axe is now half a point of Energy instead of a full point, which makes activities like clear-cutting a tree farm far more energy efficient.
[/spoiler]


That about covers things. If you made it down this far, thanks for reading, and I hope you have fun!
